+@pytest.mark.posix
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('verbose', [False, True])
+def test_exit_sigterm(qtbot, proc, message_mock, py_proc, verbose):
+    proc.verbose = verbose
+    with qtbot.wait_signal(proc.started, timeout=5000):
+        proc.start(*py_proc('import time; time.sleep(10)'))
+    message_mock.messages.clear()
+    with qtbot.wait_signal(proc.finished, timeout=10000):
+        proc._proc.terminate()
+
+    assert proc.outcome.was_sigterm()
+    assert proc.outcome.state_str() == 'terminated'
+    assert str(proc.outcome) == 'Testprocess terminated with SIGTERM.'
+    if verbose:
+        msg = message_mock.getmsg(usertypes.MessageLevel.info)
+        assert msg.text == (f'Testprocess terminated with SIGTERM. '
+                            f'See :process {proc.pid} for details.')
+    else:
+        assert not message_mock.messages
